resources.string: Android SDK platforms, NDK, CMake and the Kotlin compiler in one place
Install only the versions you need. CMake projects use the versions configured in the project; ndk-build uses the NDK selected below. CMake 3.31 requires NDK newer than r24.

OLLVM installs separately; obfuscation is opt-in. Switch ndk-build after installation, or set ndkVersion to %1$s for AIDE built-in CMake builds, then add flags such as -mllvm -fla. For external Gradle builds, use ndkPath with the installation path.
This upstream r26b package declares revision 26.1.0. Use that revision in your project.
CMake 3.31 needs NDK r25 or newer. Select/install a compatible NDK before building.

These packages require an ARM64 Android device.

Download catalog: collected only from MrIkso/AndroidIDE-NDK and ZeroAicy/AIDE-Ndk-Install, including third-party assets explicitly referenced by their installation scripts. Labels name the actual hosting repository; each entry records its source script or release. Existing installed versions outside the catalog remain usable, including OLLVM; no OLLVM download is currently offered.

https://github.com/MrIkso/AndroidIDE-NDK
https://github.com/ZeroAicy/AIDE-Ndk-Install

Installer adaptations: ZeroAicy/AIDE-Ndk-Install (AGPL-3.0), originally by MrIkso. Original package licenses and upstream notices in assets/toolchains are retained. Downloads use SHA-256 verification and separate version directories without overwriting installed tools.
